mapper.select: select count(*) clueTotal, count(if(status=1, 1, null)) clueWaitAllot, count(if(status=2, 1, null)) clueWaitFollow, count(if(status=3, 1, null)) clueFollowing, count(if(status=4, 1, null)) clueFalse, count(if(status=5, 1, null)) clueConvertBusiness from clue;
select c.*, u.name assignName, a.name activityName from clue c left join user u on c.user_id = u.id left join activity a on c.activity_id = a.id where c.id = #{id}
